cmd_help_user.other:
🤖 Throttle Bot - Multi-Window Rate Limiter

👤 **Your Commands:**
• /help - Show this help message
• /help admin - Show admin commands
• /mystatus @groupname - Check your current usage
  Example: /mystatus @home
• /config @groupname - Show rate limiting configuration
  Example: /config @home
• /setlanguage <language> - Set your preferred language
  Example: /setlanguage english

💡 **How It Works:**
Each group has up to 3 rate limiting windows (A, B, C) with different:
- Character limits (e.g., 1000, 5000, 10000 chars)
- Time windows (e.g., 30 minutes, 2 hours, 7 days)

Your messages count toward all active windows. If you exceed ANY window's limit, your messages will be automatically deleted until the window resets.

🎯 **Override States:**
- **Normal**: Rate limiting applies (default)
- **Whitelisted**: Your messages always allowed ✅
- **Blacklisted**: Your messages always blocked ❌

💬 Contact an admin if you need help!

cmd_help_admin.description: Admin help text (additional commands for admins)
cmd_help_admin.other:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👑 **ADMIN COMMANDS**
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📝 **Window Configuration:**
• /setwindow @groupname <a|b|c> <limit> <duration>
  Example: /setwindow @home a 1000 30m
• /enablewindow @groupname <a|b|c>
  Example: /enablewindow @home a
• /disablewindow @groupname <a|b|c>
  Example: /disablewindow @home a

🔧 **User Management:**
• /checkuser @groupname <user_id|@username>
  Example: /checkuser @home 123456789
• /overrides @groupname - List all overrides
  Example: /overrides @home
• /override @groupname <user_id|@username> <mode> [duration]
  **Modes**: whitelist | blacklist | clear
  **Examples**:
    /override @home 123456789 whitelist
    /override @home @testuser whitelist 7d
    /override @home 123456789 blacklist 2h
    /override @home @testuser clear

⏸️ **Group Controls:**
• /pause @groupname [duration]
  Example: /pause @home 30m
• /resume @groupname
  Example: /resume @home

🌐 **Language:**
• /setlanguage <language> - Set YOUR language
  Example: /setlanguage english
• /setlanguage @groupname <language> - Set GROUP language
  Example: /setlanguage @home russian

📊 **Information:**
• /config @groupname - Show configuration
• /mystatus @groupname - Check your usage
